name: filesystem
description: Safe project file access for Fractal MCP clients — reads, writes, edits, and manages files within your project directory only.

interface.shortDescription: Project file access for AI assistants connected via MCP like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and ElevenLabs Agents.
interface.longDescription: When you connect Fractal to an MCP client like ChatGPT, Perplexity, or ElevenLabs Agent, your AI assistant normally can't read or save files on your computer. This skill gives it safe access to your project files — reading code, editing documents, organizing folders, and saving results — all within your project directory. No random file access, no system file changes. Just your project, under your control.
defaultPrompt: Show me what files are in my project directory.
Create a new file and save the notes from our conversation into it.
Search my project files for a specific term or function.
